_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Bakalamba ba Snake kwa gridi ya {width}×{height}.
Mwaliba snake {player_id}. Mipango inayotumika: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (pano w/s/a/d).
Lengo: kubakala mpaka mwisho nelyo ukaba murefu zaidi na kupata alama ya juu zaidi (kikomo cha zunguluko {max_turns} zunguluko).

game_action.invalid_death: Inzoka {player_id} yafwile pa mulandu wa kuti tailebomba bwino.

outcome.all_dead_simul: Insoka shonse shafwile pa muku umo.
outcome.turn_limit: Ukupwisha ukupilibuka - uwacilapo ukupoka amano e wacimfya.
